source_message:
feat(gates): G-09 Redis Pre-Transaction Gate — fast-path <80ms, 28 tests

- pre_tx_gate.py: PreTxGate with 4 ordered checks against Redis:
  1. EMERGENCY_STOP (banxe:emergency_stop KEY) → BLOCK
  2. JURISDICTION (banxe:blocked_jurisdictions SET) → BLOCK (SAMLA 2018)
  3. SANCTIONS_CACHE (banxe:sanctions_hits SET) → BLOCK
  4. VELOCITY (banxe:velocity:{customer_id} ZSET, 24h/£25K) → ESCALATE
- GateDecision frozen dataclass: PASS/BLOCK/ESCALATE + rule_id + latency_ms
- InMemoryRedisStub: thread-safe, implements full Redis subset for unit tests
- Fail-open: Redis unavailable → ESCALATE (never blocks business)
- SLA: logs WARNING if total latency >80ms
- sync_blocked_jurisdictions(): loads from compliance_config.yaml into Redis SET
- sync_sanctions_cache(): populates confirmed hits into Redis SET
